text.2: Brrr! It is so cold. Snow falls all around.
text.3: Brrr! The Frozen Citadel is very cold. Soft snow falls all around, and your breath makes little clouds.
text.4: Brrr! The Frozen Citadel is bitterly cold. Soft snow drifts down all around you, and every breath makes a little cloud in the air.

text.2: The path is made of ice. Whee!
text.3: The path ahead is made of shiny ice. It is slippery, but it looks like a fun slide.
text.4: The path ahead is a long sheet of shiny ice, as smooth as glass. It is slippery, but it winds downhill like a fun slide.

feedback.3: Wheee! You zoom all the way down!

text.2: The snowman waves at you. It is alive!
text.3: Your snowman waves its stick arm! It is alive, and it wants to come with you.
text.4: To your surprise, your snowman waves its stick arm and blinks its button eyes. It is alive, and it wants to come along on your adventure.

text.1: A big yeti sits and cries.
text.2: A big yeti sits in the snow. It is crying. It lost its hat!
text.3: A big furry yeti sits in the snow, crying. Its warm hat blew away, and now its ears are cold.
text.4: A big furry yeti sits alone in the snow, crying huge icy tears. Its favorite warm hat blew away in the wind, and now its ears are freezing.

feedback.3: You find the hat in a snowbank, and the yeti cheers!
The yeti hugs you. You feel a little chilly, but happy.

text.4: What did the yeti lose in the snow?

text.1: You rest by a warm fire.
text.2: Your friend helps you to a warm fire. You rest and feel better!
text.3: Your travel friend helps you to a cozy fire in an ice cave. You drink warm cocoa, and soon you feel strong again.
text.4: Your travel friend helps you into a cozy ice cave with a crackling fire. You sip warm cocoa until the shivers go away, and soon you feel strong again.
